name: After § 52
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 52a. Strongly supports the courageous demonstrators in Iran who are calling for freedom and democracy; condemns, in the strongest possible terms, the violence used by the Iranian Islamic regime against the demonstrators, including arrests, imprisonment and torture; calls for the immediate and unconditional release of all those arrested and imprisoned for exercising their fundamental freedoms, as well as all political prisoners held in Iran; calls for the EU to designate the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps as a terrorist organisation and to further extend sanctions, as a matter of urgency, to all individuals of the regime who are complicit in the repression and murder of the protestors and in all forms of violence against them;
